title: The Phantom Client
subtitle: A Chilling Mystery Amidst Hill Station Shadows
summary: When Byomkesh Bakshi checks into the eerie Shayahadri Hotel, he finds himself surrounded by darkness—both literal and metaphorical. A mysterious client and an unsettling supernatural atmosphere draw him into a case unlike any he's faced before. Can Byomkesh separate truth from illusion before it's too late?
